title: Select release identity and execution eligibility
description: Resolve an attempt's public identity and admitted release path from existing reviewed product decisions and selected source/profile. It does not infer a new version decision, broaden routine automation, or execute publication.
inputs: Reviewed source and approved product/compatibility decisions, proposed package/version/channel, and declared supported population.
Selected release profile and available external identity observations.
outputs: Identified release attempt and supported routine or explicitly exceptional handling boundary.
No-op, duplicate/conflict, unsupported selection, or owner-intervention result.
behavior: Identify release type, justified version, source, package, tag/channel, targets, and applicable profile.
Apply retained version/compatibility policy including support withdrawals and distinguish general routine publication from the narrower supported automation population.
Reject new unresolved product/publish-mechanics decisions, malformed or unsupported profiles, and inadmissible historical replay.
Use available public identity facts to report duplicate/no-op/conflict meaning without overwriting or inventing publication.

failure_behavior.condition: Version rationale, reviewed scope, profile, or prerequisite selection is missing or contradictory.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the precise decision needed and withhold eligibility.

failure_behavior.condition: The request exceeds supported routine handling or relies on retired production recipes.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop before generation/publication and name the unsupported scope.

failure_behavior.condition: An existing public identity conflicts with the intended attempt.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the conflict or recovery need without overwrite.
